Also flaging finance on payment terms — you noted Net-60. Our standard is Net-30 for new vendors; if BlueForge requires Net-60 we’ll need approval. Grace, Jordan — can you advise on Net-60 exception workflow?

If you can reply to the four items above and re-upload a version of the intake form with the confirmed legal name, we’ll move to create the master record and generate the first PO.
